subject: Invoice orchestration: contract timing & integration plan
messages:
From: Tom Hwang <tom@invoiceflow.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sales@invoiceflow.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: InvoiceFlow — new orchestration offering & renewal timing

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the time last week. Following up with a concise package that outlines how InvoiceFlow's orchestration layer can replace our current billing connector and reduce failed invoice rates during peak batching. We know your NetSuite integration and custom tax logic are sensitive, so we included a suggested migration timeline and SOW.

High-level:
- Pilot (non-prod): 4 weeks (integration + mapping)
- Production cutover: scheduled window, ~1 day with automated rollback
- Ops handoff and monitoring: 2 weeks of supported runbook

Attachments: InvoiceFlow_SOW_v1.pdf, InvoiceFlow_security_factsheet.pdf.

Primary asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood confirm the expected monthly invoice volume and peak concurrency?
2) Are there mandatory security controls (SSO, KMS) we need to include in the SOW?

We think there's an opportunity to align contract renewal (current billing connector expires March 2027) with a staged migration starting January. If that timing works, we can offer a 10% first-year credit tied to usage.

Would love to sync for 30 minutes this week to walk the SOW.

Thanks,
Tom Hwang
Head of Partnerships, InvoiceFlow
[Attachment: InvoiceFlow_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)]
[Attachment: InvoiceFlow_security_factsheet.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Tom Hwang <tom@invoiceflow.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: InvoiceFlow — new orchestration offering & renewal timing

Tom — thanks, this is helpful. A few immediate notes from my side:

- Monthly invoice volume: ~1.2M invoices/month across hosts; monthly token of variability with peaks at month-end. Peak concurrency: estimate ~450 concurrent invoice jobs during cutover windows.
- Security: we require SSO (SAML) + support for our KMS (HashiCorp HSM behind VPC) for any key material. Can you confirm the SOW covers key-handling limitations (i.e., no vendor-side plaintext key storage)?
- Tax logic: we have custom nexus rules that must be preserved; we'll need a mapping plan for your orchestration rules vs. our NetSuite tax scripts.

Please include a line item for a non-prod replica of our NetSuite environment and any data-retention handling for archived invoices (we have a 7-year retention requirement for certain EU accounts).

Marcus and Marissa — can you weigh in on integration risk and procurement/budget cadence? If we want to start pilot Jan 4, we need legal + procurement signed off by Dec 20 to allow time for PO and SOW review.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Systems, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Sent from mobile]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: InvoiceFlow — new orchestration offering & renewal timing

Good summary Laura — tagging technical concerns so we can get an accurate estimate: 

1) NetSuite sandbox parity: We have two sandbox flavors; the SOW must specify which one you will replicate. Data volume for non-prod is ~150GB of historical invoice records (sanitized).
2) Cutover rollback plan: If we do an automated rollback, we need a fail-safe around sequence numbers and external invoice IDs so duplicate invoices aren't created.
3) Monitoring & alerts: need SLA on deduplication, retry policy, and a runbook for manual intervention.

Marissa — procurement window? Ben — budget/PO timeline? If we don't hit Dec 20, earliest pilot moves to Feb.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Hwang <tom@invoiceflow.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sales@invoiceflow.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: InvoiceFlow — new orchestration offering & renewal timing

Laura / Marcus — thanks for the specifics, appreciate the clarity. Quick responses inline: 

- KMS/keys: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations and can ensure no vendor-side plaintext storage. Will add explicit KMS handling language to the SOW.
- SSO: SAML SSO is supported; we have a standard onboarding doc.
- Non-prod replica: we can provide an infrastructure-mapped non-prod environment with sanitized data. Will specify the sandbox flavor and the expected sanitized dataset size.
- Dedup/rollback: we'll include a sequence checkpoint approach and a pre-cutover dry run in the plan.

I've attached an updated SOW draft and a security factsheet. Also proposing a 30-minute call Thursday 11/03 at 10:00 PT to finalize acceptance criteria.

Best,
Tom
[Attachment: InvoiceFlow_SOW_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: InvoiceFlow_security_factsheet.pdf]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: InvoiceFlow — new orchestration offering & renewal timing

Looping in procurement confirmation: I reviewed the SOW and security sheet. Procurement needs the following to issue a PO by Dec 20: 

- Final SOW with explicit KMS and SSO contractual language
- Signed DPA or confirmation of data processing terms (we need EU retention clauses)
- InvoiceFlow's W-9 / tax docs and an initial quote with line-item prices (pilot vs production SLA tiers)

If InvoiceFlow can deliver those items by EOD Mon 12/6, I will prepare PO_Redwood_InvoiceFlow_2026.pdf and route for signature. Otherwise, we target the Feb pilot window.

Next steps I will take:
- Draft PO (attached stub) and checklist for legal.
- Confirm budget owner and code (CapEx vs OpEx) with finance.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
